Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game but this is just the start of the competition. India Women have a long way to go in the Women's Asia Cup 2022 and their next match is against Malaysia Women. That game will be played on Monday, the 3rd of October and will start at 1 pm IST (7.30 am GMT) but our build-up will begin sooner. Do join us then. Take care and goodbye!

Jemimah Rodrigues (83 off 50 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her brilliant knock. Jemimah says that she is happy with the innings. Adds that for 6 months she did not play and it is important for her comeback. She then says that she would like to thank Mumbai because the conditions are similar to the ones here. Says that in Bangalore she made a similar wicket for practice as well. Ends by saying that they will take the positives and their bowlers bowled well.

India Women captain, Harmanpreet Kaur says they didn't start well with the ball but the two run-outs helped them and their bowlers too made a good comeback. She then commends Deepti Sharma for her all-round display. Adds that after losing two early wickets, they looked for partnerships and Jemimah Rodrigues played brilliantly and it was important for her as she was coming back from an injury. Mentions that after she herself got out, they fell 20 runs or so short of the target they looked for but it all worked out in the end.

Chamari Athapaththu, the skipper of Sri Lanka Women says that they lost a couple of wickets in quick succession, especially the run-outs hurt them. Adds that their bowlers did well but some bowlers gave away loose deliveries and credits Jemimah Rodrigues for the way she played on this pitch. Mentions that Harshitha Madavi is their future star and that is a good positive. Further says that the run-outs are a bit of a concern and they will try and improve in the next match.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Chamari Athapaththu won the toss and opted to field first on a bit of a turning track. This decision was well received by the Lankan bowlers early on and they got crucial wickets inside the Powerplay. It was then a brilliant partnership between Harmanpreet Kaur and Jemimah Rodrigues that put India Women in the driving seat with the latter going on to score her career-best 83 runs. Sri Lanka Women did well towards the back end of the first innings and kept India down to 150 runs. With the sun beating down, the track just got even better for the spinners which became evident as the game went on. The Indian spinners and fielding saw them pick up wickets at regular intervals and apart from Harshitha Madavi and Hasini Perera, no one really played well for Sri Lanka Women with the bat. In the end, it was a bridge too far for the Lankans.

Sri Lanka Women knew that India Women had quality spinners in their ranks and thus needed to attack the pacers early on. Harshitha Madavi did just that but their skipper, Chamari Athapaththu couldn't do the same. With Harshitha going greatly, a moment of indecision saw her being run-out and from then on, the Lankan innings kept on going downhill. Hasini Perera played really well in the middle order but there were just not many partnerships to help them get over the line.

India Women didn't have the best of starts with the ball as Renuka Singh was hammered in the very first over. The spinners also had a bit of a rough start but once Deepti Sharma got rid of Chamari Athapaththu, they were able to get on top of the batters. The bowling was good and there was enough turn on offer as well. The ground fielding and the catching both were superb as a couple of run-outs turned the game completely in favour of India Women. Deepti Sharma and Pooja Vastrakar both picked up a couple of wickets and Dayalan Hemalatha cleaned up the tail with three wickets of her own.

A rock-solid performance in the end from India Women in the field and they have started their Asia Cup campaign with a resounding win. Sri Lanka Women fought valiantly but have fallen well short of the target in the end.

OUT! STUMPED! That's it, Richa Ghosh whips off the bails and India Women have won the game. Dayalan Hemalatha tosses this one up nicely and pushes it outside off. Achini Kulasuriya dances down the track and completely loses her shape as she looks to go big downtown. Ghosh has all the time in the world to dislodge the bails and Sri Lanka Women have been bowled out for 109. India Women win by 41 runs!
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Dayalan Hemalatha

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss! That was full, outside off. Achini Kulasuriya looks to go big but misses to get a bat.
Loopy ball, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera looks to work it to third man but misses to connect.
Loopy delivery, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera looks to drive that but gets an outside edge just short of first slip.
Full, on off. Achini Kulasuriya tucks it to deep mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, outside off. Achini Kulasuriya misses to get a bat to that.
Achini Kulasuriya is the last batter for Sri Lanka Women.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the fielder and the wickets just keep on tumbling. On a length and around off, Hasini Perera attempts the reverse sweep and connects it well. Perera though plays it uppishly and straight to Radha Yadav at point. Yadav makes no mistake and Deepti Sharma picks up her second wicket. Hasini Perera walks back after a good knock and India Women are now just one wicket away from victory.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, onto the leg. Hasini Perera blocks it back to the bowler.
Full, on off. Hasini Perera lofts it over the bowler's head for a run.
Lofted ball, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera lofts it to long off for a run.
Inoka Ranaweera walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Soft dismissal and another bites the dust for Sri Lanka Women. This is floated up full and around off by Dayalan Hemalatha. Sugandika Kumari leans forward and drives it uppishly but straight towards short extra cover. The stand-in skipper India Women, Smriti Mandhana takes a sharp catch around her face and Dayalan Hemalatha picks up a second wicket in the over.
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Dayalan Hemalatha

Commentary.Commentary: Short, outside off. Sugandika Kumari cuts it through point for a couple.
Lofted ball, outside off. Sugandika Kumari sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Sugandika Kumari is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just when Oshadi Ranasinghe was looking to click, she holes out. This is tossed up by Dayalan Hemalatha around middle. Ranasinghe gets low and attempts the slog-sweep against the turn. Ranasinghe gets the height but not the distance and the ball goes towards the cow corner fence. Sneh Rana over there takes an easy catch and Sri Lanka Women lose their 7th wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Dayalan Hemalatha

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is swung away towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 49 needed now off 24 balls and Sri Lanka Women are still in it.
Full and at the pads, heaved away off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg. Deepti Sharma over there misfields and allows the single.
Good length, over middle, Ranasinghe backs away and taps it towards point for one.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Renuka Singh and Oshadi Ranasinghe makes full use of it. A gentle-paced delivery onto the pads, Ranasinghe picks it up and whips it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Singh gets it in the blockhole around off and Oshadi Ranasinghe manages to jam it out.
FOUR BYES! This is fuller and angled well across the left-hander. Oshadi Ranasinghe misses the drive as the ball keeps low and it goes through the keeper's legs into the fence.
Renuka Singh is brought back into the attack.
Short and outside off, played off the back foot through cover-point for a single. 60 needed now off 30 balls.
Tossed up around off, Oshadi Ranasinghe has a big swing across the line but she gets a top edge. The ball lobs up over the fielder at short third man and they get a couple of runs.

Nicely bowled! Flighted, outside off, Hasini Perera steps out and looks to go big but gets a thick outside edge. Radha Yadav at backward point makes a good stop to her right and keeps it down to a single.
FOUR! On a length and around off, Hasini Perera gets down on one knee and drags this one aerially in front of mid-wicket and picks up a boundary.
Tossed up on leg stump, Hasini Perera drives it towards mid on.
Dayalan Hemalatha comes into the attack and starts off with a loopy delivery around the pads. Oshadi Ranasinghe neatly brooms it away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Lofted ball, on middle. Oshadi Ranasinghe tucks it to short square leg for a rrun.
Oshadi Ranasinghe walks out to bat now.

OUT! LBW! Radha Yadav now gets herself onto the wickets column as Sri Lanka Women lose their 6th wicket. Yadav gives it a nice loop and bowls it full, around middle and leg. The ball turns away from the right-hander and Anushka Sanjeewani gets down on one knee to sweep, Sanjeewani gets completely beaten by the turn and gets pinged on the pads. There is a loud appeal from the Indian players and the finger is raised. 70 needed now off 37 balls.
Full ball, on off. Anushka Sanjeewani knocks it to mid-off.
Full, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani looks to work it through third man but misses.
Full, around off. Anushka Sanjeewani scoops it to fine leg for a couple.
Loppy ball, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani knocks it to mid on.
Radha Yadav (2-0-12-0) is brought back into the attack.
Full, on middle. Hasini Perera blocks it back to the bowler.
Full, outside off. Hasini Perera taps it to the fielder at short cover.
Full, onto the pads. Hasini Perera tucks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Full, onto the pads. Hasini Perera looks to knock it to mid-wicket but misses it.
FOUR! That was short, around off. Hasini Perera pulls it to deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Short, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani gets an under edge and the ball goes to third man for a run.
FOUR! Hammered away! Floated up, full and around middle, Hasini Perera shimmies down the track and whacks it back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Around off, this is turned through wide mid on for a single.
TWO WIDES! Turn and lots of it as well. This is served on a length, outside off and turns away a mile, beating the keeper. The batters scamper through for a run as well.

SAFE! This is full and around off, Hasini Perera steps out and drives it firmly towards extra cover. They look for a single but Anushka Sanjeewani is sent back and the fielder at extra covers manages to hit the stumps at the bowler's end. It is sent upstairs and the replays show that Anushka Sanjeewani did just manage to slide her bat back in time.
Floated, around off, Anushka Sanjeewani gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it down to fine leg for one more.
Around off, driven through covers for a single.

Just eludes the fielder. Tossed up, outside off, Hasini Perera dances down the track and looks to go big. The ball comes off the toe end of the bat and is skied high. The fielder at mid on runs back but fails to reach it. Two runs taken.
Fuller length, onto the pads. Anushka Sanjeewani looks to tuck it towards mid-wicket but misses to get a bat. Pooja Vastrakar appeals for an LBW but it was going down leg.
Anushka Sanjeewani is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A straightforward catch to mid on and Kavisha Dilhari has to walk back as well. Pooja Vastrakar hits the length hard and bowls it around off stump. Kavisha Dilhari looks to take it on and go downtown but the ball comes off the higher part of the part. The ball is chiipped towards mid on where Renuka Singh takes a simple catch and Pooja Vastrakar gets her second wicket of the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Renuka Singh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Short, outside off. Kavisha Dilhari cuts it to the fielder at point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Kavisha Dilhari works it to the fielder at short third man.
NO BALL! That was a high full toss, above the waist. Hasini Perera pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full, outside off. Kavisha Dilhari drives it through covers for a run.
Short, onto the pads. Hasini Perera knocks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka Women were going so well at a point inside the Powerplay but they have lost wickets in clusters which has handed India Women the upper hand in the game. Harshitha Madavi was looking good and played her shots well but an unfortunate run-out has cost her dearly. The Indian spinners have found rhythm as the game has gone on and are looking dangerous. Sri Lanka Women need a big stand here if they are to chase down the remaining 94 runs in 60 balls. It won't be easy though.
Fuller, around off. Kavisha Dilhari knocks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full, outside off. Hasini Perera lofts it towards long off for a run.
Full, ouside off. Hasini Perera plays it to mid-off.
Full, on off. Hasini Perera knocks it to the fielder at covers.
Play and a miss! Lofted ball, outside off. Hasini Perera looks to play it to covers but misses.
Lofted ball, outside off. Hasini Perera knocks it to covers.
Sneh Rana (2-0-16-0) is back on.
Fuller length, outside off. Kavisha Dilhari knocks it to covers at Deepti Sharma.
Short, outside off. Kavisha Dilhari plays it to the fielder at covers.
Full, around off. Kavisha Dilhari blocks it off the front foot.
Kavisha Dilhari is in at number 6.

OUT! LBW! That is as plumb as it can get and Pooja Vastrakar picks up a wicket in her very first over. Length ball, close to the off pole and nipping back in a touch off the deck. Nilakshi de Silva gets pushed on the back foot instead of going forward and gets completely squared up. De Silva misses the flick and gets pinged in front. The umpire raises the finger instantly and Sri Lanka Women in a bit of a slump here.
Short, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva cuts it to the fielder at point.
Short, onto the pads. Hasini Perera knocks it to deep square leg for a run.
Pooja Vastrakar to have a bowl now.
Flatter delivery, around off, this is cut away towards backward point.
Slower and down the leg side again, Nilakshi de Silva gets a faint tickle on it and the ball goes towards fine leg. They get a couple of runs.
On the pads, this is tucked away 'round the corner for a single.
THREE WIDES! Floated but full and down the leg side, Ghosh misses the ball as well and the batters pick up a couple of runs.
Around off, tapped away towards cover-point for a single.
Nilakshi de Silva is in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Catastrophe out there in the middle and Sri Lanka Women have just gifted India Women a big wicket here. Tossed up full and around middle, Hasini Perera steps down the track and clips it firmly towards short mid-wicket. Smriti Mandhana over there makes a half-stop and Perera is halfway down the track already. Harshitha Madavi is late to turn and does go for the run in the end. Mandhana throws it back to Richa Ghosh who whips off the bails and Harshitha Madavi who was looking so good has to walk back.
Flighted, around middle and leg and turning in. Harshitha Madavi flicks it past square leg for a single.
Fuller on the pads, Madav stays on the leg side and drives this to the sweeper region for a run.
Flighted ball, angling away from Perera and she drives this into the sweeper cover for a single.
BEATEN! Slower ball, outside off. Hasini Perera misses to connect the bat to it.
Full, on off. Harshitha Madavi knocks it to deep cover for a run.
Full, outside off. Hasini Perera drives it to cover for a run.
Short, outside off. Hasini Perera misses connecting the bat to it.
Full, around leg. Hasini Perera sweeps it to deep square leg. At the end of the Powerplay, Sri Lanka Women are 43/2!
Richa Ghosh is back on the field and has taken back the keeping gloves off Shafali Verma's hands.
Full, on off. Hasini Perera knocks it wide off long on for a coulple.
Short, outside off. Harshitha Madavi sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Full, on off. Harshitha Madavi knocks it back to the bowler.
Lofted ball, outside off. Harshitha Madavi looks to drive but gets an outside edge that falls just short of the fielder at first slip.
Hasini Perera is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! A moment of brilliance from Deepti Sharma and just like that Sri Lanka Women have lost their second wicket. Nicely flighted, around middle, Malsha Shehani plays it out with soft hands towards point. Sharma over there is quick tpo latch onto it and in one swift motion she throws it towards the bowler's end. There was no single thre but Shehani tried to steal a run and has ended up paying the price.

Is that a run-out? Deepti Sharma scores a direct-hit at the bowler's end and the Indian players seem to be sure that it's out. The third umpire checks the replay and it is confirmed that Malsha Shehani is short of her crease.
Radha Yadav is into the attack now.
Nagging length, turning away from off stump, Harshitha Madavi looks to run it fine but the fielder at first slip makes a sharp stop.
FOUR! Bang! Tossed up around off stump, Harshitha Madavi gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle and leg, nudged away towards mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Short and wide and duly punished. Malsha Shehani shuffles in her crease before hammering it in front of point for a boundary. Also, Harmanpreet Kaur isn't on the field either and hence, Smriti Mandhana is the acting skipper at the moment.
Tossed up, outside off, Harshitha Madavi looks to throw her hands at it but ends up slicing it around short third man for a single.
Beaten! quicker and flatter, close to the off stump. Harshitha Madavi looks to back away and cut but gets beaten past the outside edge.

'Catch it' is the call but it is in the gap. This is full and on leg stump, Malsha Shehani skips down the track and drills it uppishly past the diving fielder at mid-wicket. The ball goes towards cow corner as a couple of runs are taken.
Tossed up around middle, Malsha Shehani steps out and heaves it over wide mid on for a couple of runs.
Nicely flighted, around off and spinning in. Malsha Shehani looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

A slight halt in play as the Indian keeps Richa Ghosh has pulled up. Ghosh went for the catch on the previous delivery and might have done her hamstring here. The physio is out and having a look. The stretcher is out as well but Ghosh is finally back on her feet. For now, Shafali Verma has taken over the keeping gloves and we hope Ghosh is fine. Also, Malsha Shehani walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deepti Sharma keeps on probing and Chamari Athapaththu falls into the trap. This is tossed up around leg stump, with the ball turning away. Chamari Athapaththu goes for the unecssary slog-sweep and ends up getting a top edge on it. The ball goes high and towards square leg where Renuka Singh takes a simple catch. India Women have the first breakthrough and the Lankan skipper has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Renuka Singh b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Around off and turning away, pushed away onto the off side.
Brilliantly bowled. Deepti Sharma loops this one up, full and close to the off pole. Chamari Athapaththu looked to drive at it but gets beaten all ends up by the sharp turn.
Length ball, on the off,  Madavi cuts it to the short cover.
FOUR! That was full, outside off. Harshitha Madavi dances down the pitch and heaves it over bowler's head for a boundary.
Fuller ball, on the off, Madavi drives it to the short cover.
Short of a length ball. on the off, Athapaththu cuts it to the short cover for a single.
Play and a miss! That was full, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu misses sweeping that.
Full, outside off. Harshitha Madavi drives it through covers.
An early bowling change as Sneh Rana comes on to bowl.
FOUR! Just over the fielder at mid-off. That was full, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu steps out and slices it over mid-off for a boundary.
Short, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu knocks it to the fielder at covers.
WIDE! That was full, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu lets it go through to the keeper.
Full, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu lets it go through to the keeper.
That was full, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu misses connecting the bat.
Full, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu lets it go through to the keeper.
Slower ball, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu gets a bottom edge just short of slips.
WIDE! Deepti Sharma starts with a wide delivery way outside off.
Deepti Sharma to operate from the other end.

EDGED AND FOUR! 13 runs off the first over and Sri Lanka Women have got off to a flier here. Length ball, outside off, Harshitha Madavi throws her hands at it and gets a thick outside edge past the first slip fielder for a boundary.
Fullish length, around off, this is stroked away towards point.
WIDE! Tries to bowl full and wide but this is spilled beyond the tramline outside off.
FOUR! Harshitha Madavi means business here! Full again and on the pads, stylishly clipped away behind square on the leg side for another boundary.
Length ball, outside off and this one keeps low. Harshitha looks to reach out and cut but gets a bottom edge back to the keeper.
FOUR! A delightful drive to get underway by Harshitha Madavi. Full and outside off, driven beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Renuka Singh starts off with a fullish length, angling well across the left-hander. Harshitha Madavi reaches out and taps it towards covers.
